**Coaching note (80 words):**
When your opponent's king lacks escape squares and your rooks are active, look for forcing moves that drive enemy pieces into a mating net. Here, Rc1+ forces the knight to e1 (the only legal move), where it becomes a sitting duck attacked by both your rooks. Black's rooks control the back rank—either one can deliver checkmate on e1. The lesson: forcing moves that narrow your opponent's options often unlock tactics you don't see in quiet positions.
